note: Submodule of mailchimp_transactional. Defines the config entity type mailchimp_transactional_activity (class Entity\Activity), config prefix mailchimp_transactional_activity.mailchimp_transactional_activity.<id>, exported fields id,label,entity_type,bundle,entity_path,email_property,enabled. Admin list route mailchimp_transactional_activity.admin at admin/config/services/mailchimp_transactional/activity. Permissions: administer mailchimp transactional activity, view mailchimp transactional activity. For each ENABLED mapping, Routing\ActivityRoutes::routes() adds a dynamic route entity.<entity_type>.activity at <entity_type>/{entity}/activity (permission view mailchimp transactional activity); ActivityController::overview() fetches history from the external Mailchimp API. The API is external, so all medium/hard cases are grounded ONLY in the local config entities: setup/reset write known Activity mappings, verify/introspection read them back.

evals.prompt: What does the mailchimp_transactional_activity submodule add to a Drupal site, and what has to hold the email address it looks up?
evals.expected_output: It adds a per-entity 'Mailchimp Transactional Activity' tab that shows an entity's email delivery history from the Mailchimp Transactional API. You create mailchimp_transactional_activity config entities mapping an entity type + bundle to the property that holds the email address (email_property, e.g. user/mail); each enabled mapping registers a route on that entity type.

evals.prompt: Which permissions does mailchimp_transactional_activity define and what does each control?
evals.expected_output: 'administer mailchimp transactional activity' (restricted) controls adding/editing/deleting the Activity mappings at admin/config/services/mailchimp_transactional/activity; 'view mailchimp transactional activity' controls who can see the per-entity activity tab (in addition to being able to view the entity).

evals.prompt: How does mailchimp_transactional_activity make an activity tab appear on, say, user pages? Where do the routes come from?
evals.expected_output: For each enabled Activity config entity, Routing\ActivityRoutes::routes() (a route_callbacks entry) dynamically defines a route entity.<entity_type>.activity at <entity_type>/{entity}/activity, requiring 'view mailchimp transactional activity'. ActivityController::overview() renders the email history. Rebuild routes after adding/enabling a mapping.

evals.prompt: This site has a Mailchimp Transactional Activity mapping configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which entity type it targets and which property it reads the email address from.
evals.expected_output: The mta_user mapping targets the user entity type and reads the email from the 'mail' property: config mailchimp_transactional_activity.mailchimp_transactional_activity.mta_user has entity_type=user, bundle=user, email_property=mail, enabled=true.

evals.prompt: This site has two Mailchimp Transactional Activity mappings. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which one is disabled (its activity tab is not active).
evals.expected_output: The mta_off mapping (node/article, email_property field_email) is disabled: its 'enabled' flag is false, whereas mta_user (user/mail) is enabled.

evals.prompt: Using the mailchimp_transactional_activity module, configure this site so that user pages get a Mailchimp Transactional Activity tab driven by the account's email address. Create an enabled Activity mapping for the User entity that reads the email from the user's 'mail' property, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A mailchimp_transactional_activity config entity exists with entity_type=user, email_property=mail, enabled=true (created via the storage/entity API or the admin form at admin/config/services/mailchimp_transactional/activity).

evals.prompt: There is an existing Mailchimp Transactional Activity configuration named 'mta_toggle' but the activity tab is currently switched off. Turn it on so the tab becomes active, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: The mailchimp_transactional_activity.mailchimp_transactional_activity.mta_toggle config entity has enabled = true.
